p3/esc207:10.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:10.text: I imagine that can create some stress?

p3/esc207:11.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:11.text: No not really it's all good over here.

p3/esc207:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:12.text: Well I'm glad to hear it, sounds like you've been managing pretty well then.

p3/esc207:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:13.text: Yes because I am on winter break now.

p3/esc207:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:14.text: I assume that means you're in college then? So the stress of finals is over now?

p3/esc207:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:15.text: Yes I am. And yeah I just finished finals.

p3/esc207:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:16.text: That's good, I hope they went well for you.

p3/esc207:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:17.text: They did. Some were hard, but at least they're over now.

p3/esc207:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:18.text: Yes, now you can relax and spend time with your family without the added stress.

p3/esc207:2.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:2.text: I'm glad to hear you're doing well in these trying times.

p3/esc207:20.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:20.text: Well I hope you and your family enjoy the holidays and stay safe.

p3/esc207:26.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:26.text: Absolutely, the best thing we can do right now. Even though it's kind of a bummer.

p3/esc207:27.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:27.text: Yeah, hopefully things will go back to normal soon.

p3/esc207:28.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:28.text: I hope so too, this has been such a crazy year.

p3/esc207:4.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:4.text: How have you been managing everything?

p3/esc207:5.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:5.text: Fine I've been pretty much just trying to go out as little as possible and stay safe.

p3/esc207:6.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:6.text: Same here, it's a tough time to do that after doing it so long. Especially with the holidays coming up.

p3/esc207:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:7.text: Yes I would have to agree.

p3/esc207:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc207:8.text: Are you in close proximity to your family?

p3/esc207:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc207:9.text: Yeah I'm staying with them for the holidays and then going back home in January.

p3/esc471:10.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:10.text: What do you think I should do then?

p3/esc471:11.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:11.text: I understand, school was tough for me too.

p3/esc471:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:12.text: I suggest you tell them to knock it off or you can sit somewhere away from the bus.

p3/esc471:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:13.text: Should I just beat them up with my backpack

p3/esc471:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:14.text: No, beating them up will only get you in trouble and that won't help.

p3/esc471:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:15.text: There's another bus route. Should I just take that instead

p3/esc471:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:16.text: I think that could be a good idea if it's not too far out of your way.

p3/esc471:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:17.text: I think I will. Their comments make me very insecure

p3/esc471:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:18.text: You could also tell a teacher what is happening. They will help you out.

p3/esc471:19.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:19.text: I bet you are handsome! Don't let it get to you.

p3/esc471:2.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:2.text: I'm doing good. I need some advice

p3/esc471:20.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:20.text: The teacher would probably make fun of me!

p3/esc471:21.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:21.text: Thanks it's hard to look in the mirror now

p3/esc471:22.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:22.text: Try to tell yourself you are good looking and deserve good things to happen every morning! Look in that mirror and tell yourself good things.

p3/esc471:23.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:23.text: I'll try to be positive for once.

p3/esc471:24.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:24.text: Do you believe working out will help

p3/esc471:25.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:25.text: Working out will help a lot! When I was feeling down on myself I decided to go to the gym three times a week. It was a great confidence boost.

p3/esc471:26.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:26.text: Awesome. I will start to take care of myself and not worry about others then.

p3/esc471:27.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:27.text: That sounds like a fantastic idea.

p3/esc471:3.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:3.text: What can I help you with?

p3/esc471:4.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:4.text: Lately, my friends started to make jokes about my face being ugly. They even called my face as flat as a pan! What should I do? I see them everyday on the bus

p3/esc471:5.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:5.text: Have you tried confronting them and asking why they are being bullies?

p3/esc471:6.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:6.text: I did and they respond by saying that they are just joking and that I'm handsome. But it's starting to get on my nerves because it's all they make fun about every time they see me!

p3/esc471:7.speaker: supporter
p3/esc471:7.text: I'm sure you are very handsome! They could just be jealous.

p3/esc471:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc471:9.text: Still though, it makes me want to avoid them when I go to school on the bus

p3/esc51:0.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:0.text: Hello, how is your life at the moment? Do you want to talk about anything?

p3/esc51:1.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:1.text: I am doing ok. I just broke up with my girlfriend and sad about it

p3/esc51:10.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:10.text: Well, I think you should give her some space but people do sometimes get back together after they've separated

p3/esc51:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:12.text: You really do need to give her some space though - don't crowd her

p3/esc51:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:13.text: Should I call her directly? What should I say?

p3/esc51:14.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:14.text: I would give her a little time. Maybe two or three days? She might need some time to clear her head

p3/esc51:15.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:15.text: That's a good idea. What should I say? Should I apologize?

p3/esc51:16.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:16.text: Perhaps you could send flowers and a note asking her if she'd like to talk?

p3/esc51:17.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:17.text: That's a good idea. I will try that. Thank you.

p3/esc51:18.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:18.text: She might be feeling receptive to that but if she's not you might have to accept that it's over.

p3/esc51:2.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:2.text: so I hear you are not feeling at all your best at the moment?

p3/esc51:4.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:4.text: Do you feel as though you have no-one to talk to about this situation? I am happy to listen.

p3/esc51:5.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:5.text: I am so sad and just wonder why did it happen!!!

p3/esc51:6.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:6.text: Do you have no idea? Do you think you might have done something wrong or perhaps she was being unfaithful to you?

p3/esc51:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:7.text: We had simple disagreement and both of us were keep fighting.. now I can not get over it.

p3/esc51:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc51:8.text: Do you consider that there might be any hope for the  two of you at all?

p3/esc51:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc51:9.text: I don't know. What should I do?

p3/esc844:0.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:0.text: Hi, what I can help you with today?

p3/esc844:10.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:10.text: But nobody even pointed that why I'm failing, they just didn't care

p3/esc844:11.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:11.text: I agree it is a lot of pressure, but do not let bad teachers deter you. I would reach out to a school counselor and let them know your situation. Every school must have one.

p3/esc844:12.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:12.text: Also, physics is a difficult course to study, but if you chose it, that means you have a very strong mind.

p3/esc844:13.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:13.text: I loved physics a lot more than now, but what's the point of studying when the teachers are pulsing you not to study! (because of the quality of teaching)

p3/esc844:14.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:14.text: I hope there was someone, but I don't think we have a counselor

p3/esc844:15.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:15.text: More reason to speak to a school counselor or school administrator. We need to provide help to students, not have bad teachers deter them.

p3/esc844:16.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:16.text: Yeah, same with me! I wish I could attend a better univeristy

p3/esc844:17.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:17.text: What made you choose this particular university you are at?

p3/esc844:18.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:18.text: I didn't have another choice but this

p3/esc844:19.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:19.text: Have you looked into other Universities for the possibility of transferring

p3/esc844:2.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:2.text: I had problems in the past and somehow right now

p3/esc844:20.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:20.text: Hmmm, actually I didn't think about this option

p3/esc844:21.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:21.text: Just think about what you want in a good university and research from there

p3/esc844:24.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:24.text: you've been more helpful than my teachers!

p3/esc844:25.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:25.text: You're welcome I hope you find the perfect university for you

p3/esc844:26.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:26.text: Thanks, I wish  you luck in your future endeavours

p3/esc844:3.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:3.text: What sort of problems were in your past and now?

p3/esc844:4.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:4.text: I loved physics and I decided to attend university, but soon after I slowly lost my interest and became unmotivated

p3/esc844:5.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:5.text: What was happening in your life that made you lose interest?

p3/esc844:6.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:6.text: Actually the professors and the class atmosphere was the reason, and of course the quality of teaching

p3/esc844:7.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:7.text: so I started to skipping the classes and failing

p3/esc844:8.speaker: supporter
p3/esc844:8.text: It sounds like that is a lot of reasons to be stressed. Have you spoken to a school counselor?

p3/esc844:9.speaker: seeker
p3/esc844:9.text: Yes lots of stress and pressure. I did not, because we didn't have such things or at least I wasn't aware

p3/p3_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:0.text: Hey Nick, how have you been feeling lately?

p3/p3_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:1.text: Hey... I've been feeling pretty down recently.

p3/p3_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:10.text: It's natural to feel disappointed in situations like this. It's okay to feel hurt.

p3/p3_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:11.text: Thanks. I just can't help but think if maybe I'm overreacting.

p3/p3_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:12.text: Your feelings are valid, Nick. It's important to acknowledge when something bothers you.

p3/p3_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:13.text: True, but what if I drive him away by holding onto this?

p3/p3_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:14.text: It might help to express why those jokes affected you deeply. If he's a true friend, he should understand and respect your feelings.

p3/p3_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:15.text: Yeah, I think I should try talking to him when things cool down. I don't want to lose our friendship over this.

p3/p3_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:16.text: That sounds like a good plan. Give it some time, and approach it when you're both calmer.

p3/p3_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:17.text: I will. Thanks for listening. It really helps to talk it through.

p3/p3_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:18.text: Anytime, Nick. I'm here whenever you need to chat or get things off your chest.

p3/p3_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:19.text: I appreciate that. Hopefully, next time we'll be talking about something more positive!

p3/p3_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p3/p3_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:20.text: I'm sure we will. Hang in there, Nick. You've got this.

p3/p3_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:3.text: Yeah, it's about Henry. We argued again, and this time it got ugly.

p3/p3_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:4.text: That sounds tough. What happened between you two?

p3/p3_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:5.text: It started with some jokes they made. I found them really insensitive and hurtful.

p3/p3_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:6.text: I can understand why that would be upsetting. Did you talk to them about how you felt?

p3/p3_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:7.text: I tried, but it just turned into a shouting match. I didn't expect it would escalate.

p3/p3_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_1:8.text: That sounds really frustrating. It can be hard when someone you care about doesn't understand your perspective.

p3/p3_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_1:9.text: Exactly. I mean, we've been friends for so long. I thought we'd be on the same page about these things.

p3/p3_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:0.text: Hey Nick, it's nice to see you online. How are you doing today?

p3/p3_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:1.text: Hey, I'm feeling a mix of things actually. There's a lot on my mind.

p3/p3_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:10.text: That realization can be a lot to take in. It sounds like you value that friendship deeply.

p3/p3_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:11.text: I really do. We've been friends for so long, and it just felt wrong not having him around.

p3/p3_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:12.text: It’s understandable. When someone is that integral in your life, their absence can feel enormous.

p3/p3_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:13.text: Exactly. I guess part of me is still worried we might slip back into old patterns.

p3/p3_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:14.text: That's a valid concern. Have you both talked about how to avoid that?

p3/p3_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:15.text: A bit. We agreed to be more open when things bother us, instead of letting them build up.

p3/p3_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:16.text: That sounds like a solid plan. Communication is so key. How are you feeling about that agreement?

p3/p3_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:17.text: Hopeful, mostly. I guess I'm just trying to stay positive about it.

p3/p3_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:18.text: That’s a great mindset, Nick. It takes courage to forgive and move forward.

p3/p3_conv_2:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:19.text: Thanks. It helps to talk about it, honestly. I guess I needed to process it out loud.

p3/p3_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:2.text: I’m here to listen. What's been going on?

p3/p3_conv_2:20.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:20.text: I’m always here for that. It’s important to have spaces to express what you’re going through.

p3/p3_conv_2:21.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:21.text: Definitely. It’s nice to know I'm not alone in this.

p3/p3_conv_2:22.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:22.text: You’re certainly not alone, Nick. Anytime you need to talk, just reach out.

p3/p3_conv_2:23.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:23.text: Thanks again. I really appreciate our chats.

p3/p3_conv_2:24.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:24.text: Anytime, Nick. Take care of yourself and keep nurturing that friendship.

p3/p3_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:3.text: Well, remember how I had that fallout with Henry because of those jokes?

p3/p3_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:4.text: Yeah, I remember. That was really tough for you both. How’s that been playing out?

p3/p3_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:5.text: We finally talked again, and it was... unexpectedly emotional. We actually sorted things out.

p3/p3_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:6.text: That’s great to hear, Nick! How did the conversation go?

p3/p3_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:7.text: It started off a bit awkward, but we both apologized. We realized how much we missed each other.

p3/p3_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_2:8.text: Sometimes those tough conversations are what make friendships stronger. You must have felt a lot lighter afterward.

p3/p3_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_2:9.text: Yeah, I did. But it also made me think about how close I came to losing a really important person in my life.

p3/p3_conv_3:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment to chat? I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed.

p3/p3_conv_3:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:1.text: Of course, Nick. What's going on?

p3/p3_conv_3:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:10.text: I used to love it, but now it's just become a source of stress. I miss being excited about it.

p3/p3_conv_3:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:11.text: It's really tough when something you used to love becomes stressful. Is there anything you've considered doing differently to reignite that passion?

p3/p3_conv_3:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:12.text: I've thought about seeking outside resources or maybe talking to a different professor, but it feels daunting.

p3/p3_conv_3:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:13.text: That's understandable. Sometimes reaching out for help can feel challenging, but it could make a difference. You shouldn't have to tackle this all alone.

p3/p3_conv_3:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:14.text: I guess I could try, but I'm worried about failing either way. I hate feeling this uncertain.

p3/p3_conv_3:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:15.text: It's okay to feel uncertain, Nick. Remember when you and Henry had that fallout and reconciled? You took a brave step then and it worked out.

p3/p3_conv_3:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:16.text: True, I appreciate you bringing that up. It's nice to remember that things can turn around.

p3/p3_conv_3:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:17.text: Exactly. You've got the resilience to turn this around too. Maybe start with small steps and see how it feels?

p3/p3_conv_3:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:18.text: Yeah, maybe reaching out to a professor wouldn't be so bad to start with. Thank you for talking this through with me.

p3/p3_conv_3:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:19.text: Anytime, Nick. I'm always here to support you in any way I can. Let me know how it goes when you take that first step.

p3/p3_conv_3:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:2.text: I've been swamped with assignments, and it's starting to really wear me down.

p3/p3_conv_3:20.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:20.text: Will do. I'm actually feeling a bit lighter talking about it now.

p3/p3_conv_3:21.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:21.text: I'm glad to hear that. Keep taking care of yourself, okay?

p3/p3_conv_3:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:3.text: That sounds really tough. Are these assignments from your physics course?

p3/p3_conv_3:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:4.text: Yeah, mostly. It's just been so relentless, and I really don't feel any support from the university.

p3/p3_conv_3:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:5.text: I remember you mentioning before how the teaching quality has been lacking. Has it gotten worse?

p3/p3_conv_3:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:6.text: Pretty much. It feels like I'm teaching myself. I'm even thinking of dropping the course.

p3/p3_conv_3:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:7.text: That's such a hard decision. Dropping a course can feel like a big step, but you're the one who knows what's best for you.

p3/p3_conv_3:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_3:8.text: Exactly. I just feel like I'm drowning in work with no payoff, you know? It's exhausting.

p3/p3_conv_3:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_3:9.text: Definitely. It's important to weigh the pros and cons though. How do you feel about physics overall?

p3/p3_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:0.text: Hey Nick, how have you been doing lately?

p3/p3_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:1.text: Hey, it's been a bit tough honestly. I decided to talk to my family about everything that's been happening.

p3/p3_conv_4:10.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:10.text: That sounds really challenging, especially when support isn't available. Have you thought again about possibly dropping the course?

p3/p3_conv_4:11.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:11.text: I have, but it's also hard to think about leaving something unfinished. I don't want to feel like I've failed.

p3/p3_conv_4:12.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:12.text: It's understandable. Remember, taking a step back doesn't mean you're failing—it can be a strategic move for your well-being.

p3/p3_conv_4:13.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:13.text: That's a good point. I just wish there was more support from the university, like better teaching or someone I could talk to.

p3/p3_conv_4:14.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:14.text: Have you considered reaching out to a student advisor or counseling services at your university?

p3/p3_conv_4:15.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:15.text: I've thought about it, but it's a bit intimidating to take that step. I guess I'm worried about not being taken seriously.

p3/p3_conv_4:16.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:16.text: It's totally normal to feel that way. Maybe starting with a small step, like emailing an advisor, could make it feel more manageable.

p3/p3_conv_4:17.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:17.text: That sounds like a good way to ease into it. I think I'll give it a try.

p3/p3_conv_4:18.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:18.text: I'm proud of you for taking this step, Nick. Remember, I'm here for you and you're not alone in this.

p3/p3_conv_4:19.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:19.text: Thanks, I really appreciate it. It helps to know there's someone who understands what I'm going through.

p3/p3_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:2.text: I'm glad you opened up to them. How did that conversation go?

p3/p3_conv_4:20.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:20.text: Anytime, Nick. Keep me posted on how things go with the advisor, okay?

p3/p3_conv_4:21.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:21.text: Will do. Thanks again for being there for me.

p3/p3_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:3.text: It was a relief in some ways. They listened to me, which was good.

p3/p3_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:4.text: That's great to hear! Did they offer any advice or support?

p3/p3_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:5.text: They did offer support, but it still feels like they don't fully understand the pressure I'm under with my physics course.

p3/p3_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:6.text: I can imagine that's frustrating. Do you feel like you got to express everything you wanted to?

p3/p3_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:7.text: Mostly, yes. But it's hard for them to really grasp the academic stress when they haven't experienced it themselves.

p3/p3_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_4:8.text: It's definitely tough when others can't fully relate. How are you handling the pressure now?

p3/p3_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_4:9.text: I'm trying to stay on top of my assignments, but the quality of teaching hasn't improved. It feels like a constant uphill battle.

p3/p3_conv_5:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:0.text: Hey, I guess I just need someone to talk to right now.

p3/p3_conv_5:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:1.text: Of course, Nick. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_5:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:10.text: That makes sense. I think I could try talking to that one classmate who seemed in a similar spot last semester.

p3/p3_conv_5:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:11.text: That's a great idea! You might find you're stronger when working together. And don't forget, you've been through difficult times before, like with your friend incident. You managed to turn things around then.

p3/p3_conv_5:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:12.text: Yeah, you're right. I did sort things out with him. It was tough, but I'm glad I pushed through.

p3/p3_conv_5:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:13.text: Exactly. You've shown resilience. It's okay to feel stressed, but you've got the strength to push through this as well.

p3/p3_conv_5:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:14.text: I hope so. It's just hard to keep motivated when it feels like everything's piling up.

p3/p3_conv_5:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:15.text: That's completely valid. Taking small steps can help make those piles seem less overwhelming. Maybe set one small goal to start with.

p3/p3_conv_5:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:16.text: That's a good idea. Perhaps I could start by organizing my notes and seeing what's most urgent.

p3/p3_conv_5:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:17.text: That sounds like a solid plan, and it'll help clear your head. Remember, you're doing your best and that counts for a lot.

p3/p3_conv_5:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:18.text: Thanks for listening. I really appreciate having someone to talk to.

p3/p3_conv_5:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:19.text: Anytime, Nick. I'm glad you're opening up, and I'm here whenever you need to talk.

p3/p3_conv_5:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:2.text: It's about my physics course again. My professor contacted me today to offer help.

p3/p3_conv_5:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:3.text: That sounds like a positive step. How do you feel about it?

p3/p3_conv_5:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:4.text: I feel a bit conflicted. On one hand, it's great to know someone cares, but on the other, I'm just so stressed and unsure it can make a difference.

p3/p3_conv_5:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:5.text: It's understandable to feel that way, especially after the struggles you've had. Did the professor offer any specific advice?

p3/p3_conv_5:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:6.text: Yeah, they suggested a few resources and offered to arrange a tutoring session. But honestly, I'm not sure if it'll help with how behind I am now.

p3/p3_conv_5:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:7.text: It's good that they provided some options, but I get that feeling of being in over your head. Have you tried reaching out to other students for support?

p3/p3_conv_5:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_5:8.text: I haven't. I guess I'm just embarrassed by how far I've fallen behind.

p3/p3_conv_5:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_5:9.text: It's tough to ask for help, but remember you're not alone in this. Many students face similar challenges. It might be worth trying to find a study group or even just one buddy to tackle things with.

p3/p3_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:0.text: Hey, I've been reflecting a lot on my studies lately, and I've decided to make a big change.

p3/p3_conv_6:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:1.text: Hey Nick, that sounds like a significant step. What change are you thinking about?

p3/p3_conv_6:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:10.text: I told my family first. They were really understanding, which helped a lot, especially since they know I've been struggling.

p3/p3_conv_6:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:11.text: Family support can make a big difference. It's great that they’re understanding about your choice. Have you talked to your classmates or your best friend?

p3/p3_conv_6:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:12.text: Not yet. I'm a bit nervous about their reactions, especially since some of them are sticking with physics.

p3/p3_conv_6:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:13.text: It’s normal to feel nervous, Nick. Remember, it's about what's right for you. Those who care will likely understand and support your decision.

p3/p3_conv_6:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:14.text: Yeah, I guess that's true. Just want to feel like I'm doing the right thing, you know?

p3/p3_conv_6:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:15.text: Finding the right path for you is important, and it sounds like you're taking thoughtful steps. Trust yourself in this process.

p3/p3_conv_6:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:16.text: Thanks, that means a lot. I'm hoping this new path will be a better fit and lead to less stress.

p3/p3_conv_6:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:17.text: I believe you're on the right track, Nick. And remember, it's okay to reach out if you ever need to talk through any worries or changes.

p3/p3_conv_6:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:18.text: I will. Thanks for listening and being supportive. It really helps to talk it through.

p3/p3_conv_6:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:19.text: Anytime, Nick. I'm here for you. Good luck with everything, and I'm sure you'll do great in psychology.

p3/p3_conv_6:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:2.text: Well, I've decided to switch my major. I realized physics just wasn't the right fit for me.

p3/p3_conv_6:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:3.text: That's a huge decision, Nick. How are you feeling about it?

p3/p3_conv_6:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:4.text: I'm a mix of relieved and anxious. Relieved because I've been struggling with it for a while, but anxious because it's a big shift.

p3/p3_conv_6:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:5.text: It's understandable to feel both relief and anxiety, especially after making such an important decision. What led you to finally decide?

p3/p3_conv_6:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:6.text: I kept remembering how overwhelmed I felt with the assignments and the stress it brought. Talking to my professor helped too, but it made me see I needed a change.

p3/p3_conv_6:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:7.text: Your professor seemed like a great support. It's good that they were there for guidance. What new direction are you considering?

p3/p3_conv_6:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_6:8.text: I'm thinking of switching to a major in psychology. I've always been fascinated by how the mind works, and it feels more aligned with my interests.

p3/p3_conv_6:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_6:9.text: Psychology sounds like a fascinating field. It's wonderful that you've found something that resonates more with you. How have your family and friends reacted to your decision?

p3/p3_conv_7:0.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:0.text: Hey, got a moment to chat?

p3/p3_conv_7:1.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:1.text: Of course, Nick! What's on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_7:10.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:10.text: Not as much as I should be. I know it matters, but it's hard to prioritize.

p3/p3_conv_7:11.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:11.text: It's definitely hard to balance, especially with everything else you're managing. Maybe starting with small breaks could help?

p3/p3_conv_7:12.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:12.text: Yeah, I think I could start with just a few minutes to breathe. It's worth trying.

p3/p3_conv_7:13.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:13.text: Absolutely! Sometimes the smallest changes make a big difference. How's your relationship with your professors, now that you've switched majors?

p3/p3_conv_7:14.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:14.text: Better actually, they've been a lot more approachable in the new department.

p3/p3_conv_7:15.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:15.text: That's great to hear! Having supportive professors can really make a difference. Are you comfortable reaching out to them if you need help?

p3/p3_conv_7:16.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:16.text: I think so. It's still new to me, but knowing they're there is reassuring.

p3/p3_conv_7:17.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:17.text: It's good to have that support system. Remember that asking for help is a strength, not a weakness.

p3/p3_conv_7:18.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:18.text: Thanks, I need to remind myself of that sometimes. It's easy to forget.

p3/p3_conv_7:19.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:19.text: Totally normal to forget. Just know you're doing the best you can, and that's enough.

p3/p3_conv_7:2.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:2.text: I've been feeling a bit all over the place lately.

p3/p3_conv_7:20.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:20.text: Thanks, I really appreciate you listening. It's helped clear my head a bit.

p3/p3_conv_7:21.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:21.text: I'm glad I could be here for you. You're doing great, Nick!

p3/p3_conv_7:22.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:22.text: Thanks! I'll definitely work on taking those small breaks.

p3/p3_conv_7:23.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:23.text: Great plan! Let me know how it goes, and always feel free to reach out whenever you need to chat.

p3/p3_conv_7:24.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:24.text: Will do. Thanks again for everything.

p3/p3_conv_7:3.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:3.text: I'm here for you. Can you tell me more about what's been going on?

p3/p3_conv_7:4.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:4.text: Well, since switching my major to psychology, things have been mostly positive, but I'm just juggling a lot.

p3/p3_conv_7:5.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:5.text: It makes sense that you'd feel that way, especially during a big transition like that. How are you managing the workload now?

p3/p3_conv_7:6.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:6.text: It's more manageable than physics, for sure. But I still get anxious about falling behind.

p3/p3_conv_7:7.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:7.text: That anxiety is understandable. It's a lot to handle. Have you found any new strategies that help with the anxiety?

p3/p3_conv_7:8.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_7:8.text: I've been trying to stay organized with a planner, but sometimes it feels overwhelming.

p3/p3_conv_7:9.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_7:9.text: Organization can be really helpful, but it's important to avoid burnout. Are you taking time for yourself, too?

p3/p3_conv_8:0.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:0.text: Hey, Nick! How are you holding up these days?

p3/p3_conv_8:1.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:1.text: Hey! Overall, I'm doing okay, but there's something on my mind recently.

p3/p3_conv_8:2.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:2.text: I'm here to listen, Nick. What's been on your mind?

p3/p3_conv_8:3.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:3.text: Well, I reconnected with my ex-girlfriend, and it's been a bit of an emotional rollercoaster.

p3/p3_conv_8:4.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:4.text: That sounds like a big step. How do you feel about reconnecting with her?

p3/p3_conv_8:5.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:5.text: I feel relieved in some ways. We've both grown and matured since our breakup, but it's also scary.

p3/p3_conv_8:6.speaker: supporter
p3/p3_conv_8:6.text: It's understandable to have mixed feelings. What scares you about it?

p3/p3_conv_8:7.speaker: seeker
p3/p3_conv_8:7.text: I guess I'm afraid of falling back into the same patterns we had before.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Exactly. I mean, we've been friends for so long. I thought we'd be on the same page about these things.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Well, since switching my major to psychology, things have been mostly positive, but I'm just juggling a lot.

spans.exact_quote: Definitely. It’s nice to know I'm not alone in this.
